versions.changelog:
Initial release of 热点检索输出报文 (redian-jiansuo-baochuwen):

- Scheduled delivery of recent tech/AI news summaries in pure text (default: 3 short articles, 400 characters each, from whitelisted companies only).
- All key parameters are configurable, including model, search provider, whitelist, word count, delivery channel, recipients, and schedule.
- Strict anti-hallucination and content filtering rules; only facts with verifiable sources, no images, no outside companies/topics, and sensitive words avoidance.
- Flexible for various channels: supports WeChat (iLink AI), Telegram, Slack, Email, etc.
- Includes detailed configuration guide, troubleshooting section, and operational steps for environment setup and maintenance.
